parameters.description: Specify the format of the response returned by the server. If not specified, the default format is `application/json`.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

audio_id.description: The source audio ID for generating MIDI will extract MIDI content based on the existing audio.

callback_url.description: The callback address used to receive processing results. If not specified, the results will be returned directly in the response body.
